title: Task
description: A document in the Firestore 'tasks' collection of the TodoApp-FlutterFlow app.

completed.description: Whether the task has been marked done.

created.description: Firestore timestamp for when the task was created, serialized as an RFC 3339 date-time string.

user.description: Firestore document reference to the owning user, serialized as its path.
